metadata.description: OutSystems MCP plugin for Claude Code and Claude Desktop

plugins.name: outsystems
plugins.description: Edit, publish, deploy, and search OutSystems apps, and manage external libraries, from your AI assistant. Connects to your own OutSystems tenant's MCP server over OAuth.

plugins.name: legacy-modernization
plugins.description: Modernize legacy applications onto OutSystems, or build new ones, on a live ODC tenant: the end-to-end build playbook, OSUI/theming idioms, UI feature recipes, shared-block editing, design parity, in-app AI assistants, the auth/deploy failures that pass every visible validation, the migration close-out document pair, the /outsystems-app-generation light path, the /extract-requirements and /workflow-legacy-app pipelines, and the designer/developer/reviewer/tester roles.
